schema.description: One external carrier progress report (ADR 0015). No authentication - the route is exactly as privileged as the scans route.

carrierEventId.description: The carrier's own event id; with carrierId it forms the scanId, so a re-sent report is a duplicate scan.

at.description: The observation instant; at most five minutes into the future (clock-skew allowance).
